notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup (trial). Product fit: SMB support platform using LLM for chat + embeddings for KB search. Primary ask: reduce per-conversation cost - wants concrete levers (batching, caching, prompt compression, token audits).

Background/context: migrating from OpenAI due to cost at scale. Customer runs multi-turn chat (avg conv length ~600 tokens), 10-15 concurrent users typically, spikes to ~25 during daytime peaks. Also runs semantic search over ~100k docs (embeddings refresh daily). Currently making per-request calls with minimal batching; no prefix caching.

Performance targets: latency target for chat <=250ms p50 (willing to accept higher p95 for non-critical paths). Throughput: steady 10-20 req/s, peaks ~40. Cost target: reduce token spend by 30-50% vs current.

Security/compliance: SMB - SOC2 important for roadmap but not blocker now; needs audit logs and retention controls. Deployment: public cloud (self-serve hosted API) - no VPC now.

Technical asks (from call):
- Walkthrough of batching and guided config (how to batch user messages and embeddings ingestion).
- Prefix/KV caching recommendations for customer support dialogs to avoid re-tokenizing context for repeated queries.
- Prompt compression techniques and examples (e.g., templating, slotting, summarization heuristics).
- Token usage audit on their sample logs (where are tokens being spent, suggestions to trim).
- Rough estimate on cost delta if switching to Redwood Hosted with recommended batching/cache settings.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We're seeing the token bill balloon as conversations go multi-turn - need hard levers to control that."
- "If you can show 30%+ cost reduction with a quick config change, we can move this to pilot."

Current integration status: SDK integrated for basic chat calls, embeddings pipeline wired but not batched. Using frontend to send full conversation history every turn (opportunity to implement selective context + compression). Trial credits used ~60%.

Recommended next steps (short):
- Set 60m technical scoping with SE (Daniel) to review logs and propose batching + caching config (action: schedule in next 7 days).
- Run token usage audit on provided logs (RDW-3421) and return short report (expected 3-5 business days).
- Provide prompt compression examples + quickstart snippets for SDK (send drive link to examples).
- Offer optional 2-week POC with guided config for hosted API to measure actual cost savings on production-like traffic.

Open questions / blockers:
- Budget: needs approval from Head of Ops for pilot spend.
- Measurement: wants clear KPI to decide (cost/conv, latency p50/p95).
- SE capacity: wants earliest availability for scoping call.

Internal notes for AE: track conversion to pilot if audit shows >30% savings. Attach trial usage dashboard and token breakdown in CRM. Follow up cadence: 3 business days post-scoping for audit report.
